S3_old_holdout.convention: original holdout two-bank convention: banks A and B of 256 seeds each (seedbook seed_blocks.holdout, two_bank_diagnostics of the holdout report); resampled independently within each bank, synchronously across the three profile centers; independent of the upper-bracket streams. (The archived holdout primary intervals used unstratified 512-seed resampling; the rule-surface reanalysis used four 128 strata; neither is used here.)
S3_old_holdout.seed_list: full_icu_confirmation_2026-10-08 configs/holdout_all.json seeds (512) = seedbook seed_blocks.holdout A + B
S3_old_holdout.verified_by: bank A/B values reproduced against rule-surface old_full_* banks and holdout report two_bank_diagnostics to <=1e-12

independent_module.bank_A: positions 0-127 (old bank A core: first 128 of ordered holdout bank A)
independent_module.bank_B: positions 128-255 (old bank B core: first 128 of ordered holdout bank B)
independent_module.lower_bracket: independent_target_candidate records of the original holdout (cluster+local sites) at those 256 seeds, reordered to the upper seed order; = rule-surface report independent_center_matched256 (rule_surface analyze.py: core = rows 0..127 and 256..383 of old A+B order)
independent_module.seed_list: rule_surface configs/independent_upper.json seeds = old holdout ordered banks A[:128] + B[:128] (old_input_index.json independent_upper_comparison_seeds; seedbook seed_blocks.holdout)
independent_module.verified_by: bank A/B control, policy, F reproduced against rule-surface report banks to <=1e-12

sensitivity_module.verified_by: bank A/B values of all 6 conditions reproduced against sensitivity report to <=1e-12

bootstrap.method: whole-seed resampling with replacement: per bank, rng.integers(0,n_bank,(chunk,n_bank)) -> multiplicity counts; sums = counts @ per-seed (C0,D0,C1,D1); rates as ratio of sums
bootstrap.quantiles: numpy.quantile method=linear on all draws (no undefined draws occurred)
